research.tip: Set a timer for the last 30 minutes before a study block, turn off all notifications and put devices away, then resume with a quick 5‑minute review.

data.title: Med Toppers Digital Detox Kaise Karte Hain
data.title_en: How Medical Toppers Actually Do Digital Detox

scenes.text: Toppers exam se pehle phone fekte nahi hain.
scenes.text_en: Top students do not throw their phones away before exams.
scenes.text_hi: टॉपर exam से पहले phone फेंकते नहीं हैं।

scenes.text: Extreme digital detox ka trend sirf guilt deta hai.
scenes.text_en: Extreme digital detox trends often just create unnecessary guilt.
scenes.text_hi: Extreme digital detox का trend सिर्फ guilt देता है।

scenes.text: Asli trick unka screen management hai, aur teesra step gamechanger hai.
scenes.text_en: Their real trick is screen management, and step three changes everything.
scenes.text_hi: असली trick उनका screen management है, और तीसरा step gamechanger है।

scenes.text: Research kehti hai zyada screen time sustained attention ghata sakti hai.
scenes.text_en: Research suggests high screen time may be associated with reduced attention.
scenes.text_hi: Research कहती है ज़्यादा screen time sustained attention घटा सकती है।

scenes.text: Phone use kam karne se perceived stress bhi kam lagta hai.
scenes.text_en: Reducing phone use may also be linked to lower perceived stress.
scenes.text_hi: Phone use कम करने से perceived stress भी कम लगता है।

scenes.text: Ye us hostel roommate ko bhejo jo har exam pe detox karta hai.
scenes.text_en: Send this to that roommate who tries extreme detoxes before exams.
scenes.text_hi: ये उस hostel roommate को भेजो जो हर exam पे detox करता है।

scenes.text: Toh topper routine kya hai? Pehle, study block se tees minute pehle notifications off.
scenes.text_en: So what is their routine? First, silence notifications thirty minutes before studying.
scenes.text_hi: तो topper routine क्या है? पहले, study block से तीस minute पहले notifications off.

scenes.text: Phir, device ko aankhon se door kisi dusre kamre mein rakho.
scenes.text_en: Next, place your devices out of sight in another room.
scenes.text_hi: फिर, device को आँखों से दूर किसी दूसरे कमरे में रखो।

scenes.text: Aur teesra, padhai shuru karne se pehle paanch minute quick review karo.
scenes.text_en: And third, do a quick five-minute review before opening new topics.
scenes.text_hi: और तीसरा, पढ़ाई शुरू करने से पहले पाँच minute quick review करो।

scenes.text: Screen band karne se zyada zaroori attention protect karna hai.
scenes.text_en: Protecting your attention matters far more than just shutting screens off.
scenes.text_hi: Screen बंद करने से ज़्यादा ज़रूरी attention protect करना है।

scenes.text: Smart detox yahi hai, phone fekne ki bilkul zaroorat nahi.
scenes.text_en: That is smart detox, without throwing your phone away.
scenes.text_hi: Smart detox यही है, phone फेंकने की बिल्कुल ज़रूरत नहीं।

data.description: Top medical students don't quit their phones completely before exams—they manage their attention smartly. Here is what research and real topper study routines actually suggest about screen time and focus.

fixes: Strengthen hook with a clearer pain/curiosity line within 9 words
Add a definitive CTA at the end, e.g., "Abhi phone study room ke bahar rakho"
Remove filler line about extreme detox guilt to tighten script
Introduce open‑loop curiosity earlier, e.g., in scene 2, to boost retention
